full_prompt_en: A cinematic digital illustration shows a young traveler standing on a rough grassy rise beneath a violent storm. She occupies the left third in a three-quarter side view, short windswept hair streaming backward as she looks toward the burst of light to the right. Simple travel clothes, a tied belt, and dark wrist covering are described with angular folds and compact shadow shapes rather than ornamental detail. Behind her, vast charcoal and blue-green clouds roll across the sky in broad painterly masses. A branching network of violet-pink lightning descends along the right edge and cuts diagonally across the middle, its white-hot cores bleeding soft magenta light into the surrounding air. Warm yellow-orange illumination rises from the low horizon, catching the side of her face, hair, arms, and clothing while leaving most of the figure in mauve shadow. Broken grasses and dark earth occupy the bottom edge, with a few thin stems silhouetted against the glowing background. The design balances a small, sharply readable figure against the scale of the storm, using the lightning as a brilliant counterweight rather than filling every area with detail. Fine line accents define the face and hands, while clouds remain broad and slightly textured. The whole frame captures a tense pause before movement through a striking contrast of dark weather, electric violet, and low amber light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅电影感数字插画描绘一位年轻旅人站在粗粝的草坡上，头顶是一场猛烈的暴风雨。她以四分之三侧面姿态占据画面左侧三分之一，短发被风吹向身后，目光朝向右边爆发的亮光。简洁的旅行衣装、束起的腰带和深色护腕由棱角分明的衣褶与紧凑阴影塑造，而非繁复装饰。她身后，大团炭黑色和蓝绿色乌云以宽阔、绘画感的块面席卷天空。分叉的紫粉色闪电沿右缘落下，又斜切过画面中段，炽白的核心向周围空气晕染出柔软的洋红色光。暖黄橙色光线从低处地平线升起，照到她的脸侧、头发、手臂与衣服，身体大部分仍留在暗紫色阴影里。断续的草丛和深色土地占据底边，几根细茎映在发光的背景前。设计以小而清楚的人物平衡巨大风暴，让闪电成为强烈的视觉配重，却没有把每一处都填满细节。纤细线条勾出面部与双手，云层则保持宽阔且略有肌理。整幅画通过阴沉天气、电光紫色与低处琥珀光的强烈对比，定格了行动前紧绷的一瞬。
style_prompt_en: The digital illustration combines compact ink-like contour accents with broad, textured painterly masses. Charcoal and muted blue-green occupy most of the upper field; a narrow low band of yellow-orange light lifts the darkest shapes from below. Intense violet and pink-white lines branch through the composition, creating a bright diagonal rhythm and soft colored bloom around each high-contrast edge. A small, readable midground form balances the expansive atmosphere, with more precise edges reserved for the focal region and rougher, dissolving edges in the surrounding space. Foreground grasses become quick dark strokes against the light. The palette moves from cool storm tones through mauve shadow to amber rim illumination, keeping the center of attention where those temperatures meet. The whole frame feels charged and cinematic because expressive line, broken texture, and luminous contrast carry the motion.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅数字插画将紧凑、近似墨线的轮廓重点与宽阔而有肌理的绘画块面结合起来。炭黑和低饱和蓝绿色占据上方大部分区域；下方一道狭窄的黄橙色亮带把最深的形体托起。强烈的紫色与粉白色线条在构图中分叉，形成明亮的斜向节奏，并在每条高反差边缘外留下柔和的彩色光晕。一个小而清晰的中景形体平衡广阔的氛围，较精确的边缘留给视觉焦点，周围空间则以更粗粝、逐渐消融的边缘处理。前景草叶成为亮光前迅疾的深色笔画。色盘由冷调风暴色穿过暗紫色阴影，抵达琥珀色轮廓光，让注意力停在冷暖交会处。整幅画的张力和电影感来自富于表情的线条、破碎肌理与发光的明暗对比。
name: Lit by lightning
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
